content.short: Parisian Building is a metaverse project on Cardano Blockchain developed using unreal engine 5, representing the beautiful infrastructure of Paris.
content.description:
Parisian Building Season 2 is a NFT project for architecture and cryptocurrency enthusiasts. These NFTs represent the famous Haussmannian buildings, time recognized for their beauty and their world fame. We have created 10,000 unique Parisian buildings especially for you!

They are all unique by their rarity, and they are intended to be integrated into the WEB 3 with the project PARISIAN META being built on last generation tool!
